upstream.published: Published site output for C2PA Technical Specification version 2.5 (October 2026, marked 'is-current is-latest' in build/site/index.html and Appendix F.1 '2.5 - October 2026'). In c2pa-org/specifications, build/site/ is the built Antora site deployed directly from main to spec.c2pa.org by .github/workflows/publish.yml, and C2PA_Specification.html.md is the per-page Markdown mirror generated alongside C2PA_Specification.html by buildsite.sh ('npm run llm-export') from the private c2pa-org/specs-core antora-2.5 AsciiDoc source. The newest git tag in the repository is v2.3 (January 2026); versions 2.4 and 2.5 are published on main without git tags.

structure_note: Text is kept verbatim and NOT rendered: shortcodes, JSX components, HTML and link targets stay as the author wrote them. A Markdown file is divided by its own ATX headings outside fenced code; any other text file is one section, fenced verbatim. No division was inferred. 13 files form this one source; source.sha256 is the sha256 of their sha256sum listing, in files order. 12 image file(s) are recorded with their digests and not ingested.
